highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 3.119.4 expands platform support while fixing rendering and deployment issues across supported runtimes.
highlights_body: The release adds Linux Bionic assets, restores legacy .NET Framework targeting, and addresses Android, GTK, tvOS, and Windows reliability.

bullets.lead: Linux Bionic and additional Tizen assets added
bullets.detail: Adds Linux Bionic native assets and broadens Tizen native build coverage.
Adds a net48 target for Windows consumers that still require the full .NET Framework.
Fixes Android MAUI tab rendering, GTK4 Cairo failures, and tvOS device and simulator native packaging.

bullets.lead: Windows systems without DirectX 12 start safely
bullets.detail: D3D12 is delay-loaded so applications do not fail at startup when the library is unavailable.

preview_summaries.v3.119.3-preview.1.1: The earlier preview introduced native hardening and deployment fixes that roll forward into this release.
preview_summaries.v3.119.4-preview.1.1: Preview 1 added broad platform support improvements and rendering reliability fixes.

harfbuzz_summary: Updates HarfBuzzSharp with the corresponding native text-shaping maintenance changes.
